items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Yeah. I'd be, when he was with Jack. Yeah. He was with his brother there. Yeah. And Chani, me, and Chester and Joe Stratton.

ctx.x: Clayton, yeah. King Clayton, yeah. King Clayton, yeah. King Clayton for a while. Mm-hm. And then I played with Lewis Dorman band. Mm-hm. And Auguste Dush . I played with Sam Morgan for a good while. Mm-hm. I played a little while with Joe Howell. And that kid Howell I played with him- I mean Joe Howell I played with him for a little while because he had Frankie Duce in there with him. That's right. The boys wouldn't stick with him on account of Frankie Ducey, we all quit. He had a good band too. The kid Howard, I…
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Ask him who was in the band when Muck Carey was in the band, I'd be. Right. Yeah, when he finishes there. Then I, uh. He said who was in the band when Muck Carey was there?

Yeah. I'd be, when he was with Jack. Yeah. He was with his brother there. Yeah. And Chani, me, and Chester and Joe Stratton. No, Chester and, uh, that was, let's see. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. He was with Jack when he come with him wasn't he? Something was mad all down there you know. Sip of lettuce you know. And he died you know. He had to stop playing.
